parts.gloss: to those who do not know

words.gloss: to those who do not know

literal: Do not express pain, that which pained, to those who do not know; do not display weakness enemies in the presence of.
translation: Do not express your pain to those who cannot understand it. Do not display your weakness in the presence of your enemies.
modern: உங்கள் துன்பத்தை அதனைப் புரிந்து கொள்ளாதவர்களிடம் சொல்லாதீர்கள். உங்கள் பலவீனத்தை பகைவர்களிடத்தில் வெளிப்படுத்தாதீர்கள்.
explanation: The couplet advises caution in revealing one's vulnerabilities to the wrong people. It warns against sharing grief with those who lack the empathy to understand it, as it brings no comfort. Similarly, it counsels against showing any sign of weakness to enemies, as they will exploit it to their advantage. The parallel commands 'நோவற்க' (do not express pain) and 'மேவற்க' (do not display) emphasize guarding one's inner state.
